item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"ARC-AGI-2 public test problems, inspected official software and scoring rules are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The passage describes rule inference by AI systems, system comparisons and broader reasoning claims."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid examples, new inputs and exact output requirements are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Two attempts, verified settings and spending limits are described; other testing routes can differ."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact matches earn input credit, averaged within problems and then across problems."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring rules from examples is explicitly linked to reasoning with little specialist knowledge."},{"id":7,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty testing and removal of repeated solution rules explain selection."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and corrections are documented, but comprehensive reference-answer checks during development are unclear."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise rule inference and combining ideas, but evidence concerns two-dimensional grids."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching rewards successful transformations, but unintended routes to correct outputs remain incompletely assessed."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging procedure is explicit, but support for its weighting as a measure of reasoning is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct answers, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI results and human difficulty data provide context, but the human study covered a larger puzzle pool."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run; no repeated-run variability study is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No estimates or ranges of repeated-test score variation are provided."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Design checks address program search and repeated rules, without establishing that all shortcuts were examined."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, but public problems remain accessible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific tuning is discouraged and verified feedback is restricted to protect evaluation."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links grid scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching help comparisons, but other routes differ and broader fairness remains unresolved."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The public licence and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and code-review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated corrections and exact code changes are recorded, but affected scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid reasoning claims have direct support; broader connections to intelligence remain unvalidated."}],"instrument_review":"The passage clearly describes the grid task and scoring. Development checks and marking tests support its use for comparing grid-solving performance under specified conditions. Evidence is weaker for score stability and broader intelligence interpretations.","supported_claims":["The benchmark assesses producing exact grid transformations from examples.","The official software awards partial problem credit when only some new inputs are solved.","Human solving data informed puzzle selection and matching of test-set difficulty."],"documented_problems":["Averaged problem credit differs from the dataset description of a fully solved problem.","Public corrections identify erroneous squares and unclear examples.","Testing routes can use different conditions, complicating comparisons."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variability and sensitivity to testing setup.","Evidence predicting performance outside grid problems.","Recalculated results for every affected revision."],"reinterpretations":["A score is an average of within-problem success fractions, not necessarily the percentage of fully solved problems.","Human difficulty matching does not establish equal difficulty for AI systems.","Public-test results do not automatically establish performance on unfamiliar hidden problems."],"closing_note":"Items about testing should distinguish whether checks occurred from whether they were comprehensive. The review concerns public problems; hidden-test policies provide context but do not make hidden results fully inspectable."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 question pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, tested AI systems and comparison uses are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules and images, and required text or yes/no answers are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but complete historical inputs and settings are not linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, yes/no credit and equal weighting of six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link the tasks to finding, interpreting and applying engineering requirements."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Practical materials justify relevance, but one rulebook and uneven task counts limit representativeness."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several relevant activities, but only a limited range of engineering work."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions earn credit, but wording, formatting and incomplete references can affect marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but evidence supporting the overall or separate skill interpretations is absent."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and examination of scoring problems document some testing."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide context; human engineer results are absent and information supplies differ."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the inputs and do not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors examined changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation and small-group score sensitivity provide limited context, but main comparison uncertainty is insufficient."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and familiarity were considered, but unintended scoring routes were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and protected tests are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules for training on questions and repeated submissions were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No evidence establishes prediction of success on other documents or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Input differences are described, but whole-rulebook and retrieved-passage systems receive different information."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but historical software, settings and inputs do not fully support reproducing every result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found in the inspected material."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on score comparisons are not clearly documented."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges important limits, while broader engineering interpretations and fine rankings lack sufficient support."}],"instrument_review":"DesignQA provides practical engineering tasks and useful tests of presentation and information supply. Its scores require caution because marking can depend on wording, task groups are uneven and systems receive different inputs. Broader engineering competence and small ranking differences remain insufficiently supported.","supported_claims":["The benchmark examines six activities involving Formula SAE rules and vehicle materials.","Testing explored effects of passages, labels, scale bars and image highlighting.","The paper acknowledges uncertainty about performance on different technical documents."],"documented_problems":["Formatting and valid rules missing from references can affect credit.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, allowing an always-yes strategy to earn decision credit on that portion.","Systems receive different information supplies.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding paper question count."],"missing_information":["Repeated runs with identical conditions and adequate uncertainty for main comparisons.","Comprehensive marking validation and remaining reference-error rates.","Complete historical reproduction records, reuse rules and score-impact change records.","Systematic exposure checks and training or submission policies."],"reinterpretations":["Results describe an AI together with its information supply.","Equal group weighting does not establish a unified engineering-understanding measure.","The always-yes opportunity does not show that any tested AI used it.","Real engineering materials establish relevance without establishing transfer to other engineering work."],"closing_note":"Items about testing should credit limited checks without implying complete validation. Repeated testing with changed passages should be distinguished from identical-condition repetition; unavailable reuse rules do not establish that reuse is prohibited."}]}
